title: cxg-author-probe pulled-column sidecar (v0)
description: Metadata sidecar for the full-column pull stage. The actual joinids + values live in a sibling Parquet (or .npz) file referenced by 'data_path'; this JSON describes shape, dtype, and provenance.

picks.description: Columns actually pulled (subset of picks-v1.picks; missing columns are noted under 'missing').

missing.description: Columns that were requested but absent from the source.

data_path.description: Path to the data sidecar — .parquet by default, with columns observation_joinid + one per picked column.
